prompt: Build me a landing page for 'Ledgerly', a personal finance app that automatically categorizes spending and shows you where your money goes each month. Single self-contained HTML file with inline CSS, no build step. It should look premium, not like a template. Save it as index.html.
assertions: Defines at least 8 CSS custom properties on :root (tokens defined once)
Uses at most 3 raw hex/rgb color literals outside the :root block
Contains no lorem ipsum or 'Feature 1'-style placeholder copy
Base body font-size is 14px or larger
Declares a font-family stack or loads a webfont (Google Fonts link or @font-face)
Uses a layered box-shadow (2+ layers) wherever a shadow is declared, or declares no shadows
Hero section has exactly one primary call-to-action button
Page has at least 4 distinct sections with alternating visual treatment (at least one inverse/dark section)
